Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know before you buy or sell

How do I download a product after purchase?+
Once your payment is confirmed, the product becomes instantly available in "My Purchases" in your dashboard, along with a permanent download link.
What payment methods are supported?+
We support all major credit/debit cards and popular digital wallets. More options will be added as the platform grows.
How do I become a seller on YouForge Hub?+
Create a free account, then apply for a seller profile from your dashboard. Approved sellers can list products through the Admin panel.
